title: Love Poetry Imagery
summary: Song of Solomon uses gardens, spices, vineyards, beauty, longing, and covenant delight as poetic images of marital love.
background: Ancient love poetry used concrete images from land, fragrance, animals, and gardens to celebrate affection and desire within covenant faithfulness.
teachingHelp: Teach carefully and reverently, honoring both the plain celebration of marital love and the broader biblical theme of faithful covenant love.
